instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: This magnet is a souvenir from my trip to Cornwall.
atoms.b: This magnet is a ((souvenir)) from my trip to Cornwall.

atoms.a: Some people think graffiti is art, while others think it damages property.
atoms.b: Some people think ((graffiti)) is art, while others think it damages property

atoms.a: Gemma insists that celebrity gossip magazines are going out of style
atoms.b: Gemma insists that celebrity ((gossip)) magazines are going out of style.

atoms.a: The word ghetto often has a negative connotation.
atoms.b: The word ((ghetto)) often has a negative connotation.

atoms.a: Samir is a truly genuine friend.
Oliver normally takes showers but occasionally takes baths.
atoms.b: Oliver normally takes showers but ((occasionally)) takes baths.
